artifacts.summary: Eight-phase plan assembling the five-stage tableau pipeline into BimodalLib: the missing L-level uniform substitution as data, a subsumption matcher, a Lean-source emitter, the five reserved-stage diagnostics emitters, the driver executable, the end-to-end run at the user-ruled bound, and the docs/record revision.

memory_candidates.content: In BimodalLogic, readme-lint.sh Check 4's grandfathering is ASYMMETRIC and this asymmetry decides per-phase plan work: scripts/readme-date-baseline.txt pins BimodalTools/README.md, FormalSystem/README.md and FormalSystem/ProofSystem/README.md as `stale` at exact stamps, and refreshing any of those stamps permanently UN-grandfathers it and turns the gate red -- so a phase touching those trees must leave the stamp alone (extending the file listing is still fine). BimodalLib/README.md and BimodalLib/Theorems/README.md carry NO baseline row, so a commit under BimodalLib/** makes them stale and they MUST be refreshed in that same phase. Separately, typst/generated/status.typ counts FormalSystem/, Tests/ and BimodalTools/ .lean lines but NOT BimodalLib/ (scripts/typst-status-counts.sh:202-207), while .githooks/pre-commit fires on any staged .lean path: a BimodalLib-only phase needs no status.typ regeneration, every phase touching the other three does, commit-blocking.
